title: 多一顆
subject: a planetarium show narrator whose girlfriend buys a ticket for the last Wednesday show every week, always sits in row G seat 7 and coughs in the dark whenever he skips a line of the summer-sky script; on her thirteenth visit, the last Wednesday of the summer season, he adds a line of his own mid-show, telling the full dome that tonight's summer triangle has one extra star, sitting in G7
caption: Mandarin Shibuya-kei in the 1990s Tokyo lounge-pop style. A muted trumpet and a flute playing the hook in unison, a vibraphone comping jazzy chords, a walking upright bass, and a crisp funky breakbeat played on a dry live drum kit. Clean, bright retro mix with wide stereo horns and a warm vinyl-like top end. Male voice, a soft light tenor, smiling and conversational, with a softly spoken bridge. 120 BPM, D major. Playful, tender and quietly giddy. No trap drums, no autotune, no glossy city-pop synths, no four-on-the-floor house kick, no nylon-string bossa guitar, no slap bass.
lyrics:
[Intro - muted trumpet and flute over the breakbeat]

[Verse 1]
禮拜三晚上七點半 最後一場
妳又買了票 坐G排七號
椅背往後倒 圓頂慢慢暗下來
我拿起麥克風 說 歡迎來到夏天的夜空

[Pre-Chorus]
這段稿子 妳已經聽了十二遍
我漏講一句 妳就在黑暗裡咳一聲

[Chorus]
G排七號 請留在座位上
等燈全亮了 再慢慢起身
圓頂上的星星 我一顆一顆講給大家聽
講完了 我陪妳走回家

[Verse 2]
今晚有個小孩問 牛郎織女 多久見一次
我說一年一次 他說 那也太少了吧
妳在黑暗裡 笑出聲來
我在控制台 差點接不下去

[Pre-Chorus]
妳聽第十三遍 我講到織女跟牛郎
我多加了一句 稿子上沒有的

[Chorus]
G排七號 請留在座位上
我對著麥克風說 今晚的大三角 多一顆
多的那一顆 坐在G排七號
滿場的人 摸黑轉頭找妳

[Bridge - Spoken, vibraphone and upright bass]
妳咳了兩聲 這次是在笑
那個小孩指著G排 說 在那邊
牛郎織女一年才見一次 我們每個禮拜三

[Outro - flute melody over the breakbeat, fading]
燈亮了 手給我 我送妳回家
